messages.text: just feeling kinda off tonight

I hear you, and it is okay to have nights where things feel unsettled. Sometimes our minds pick up on stress even when we aren't sure why. Would you like to share what's on your mind, or just sit with the feeling for a bit? I am here to support you either way.
yeah... everything feels like it's piling up, y'know? work, skin acting up again, just *everything*

It sounds like you are carrying a heavy load right now between work and your health. When physical discomfort mixes with daily stress, it can feel truly exhausting to manage. I want you to know that your feelings are completely valid given what you are dealing with. Would it help to talk through one of these things, or do you just need a moment to vent?
it's fine, really... just been a long week. i'll be okay after a good sleep 💤

I hope you are able to get that restful sleep you need tonight. Listening to your body and prioritizing rest is a great way to handle a tough week. Please remember I'm here if you need to talk again tomorrow or anytime. Take care of yourself.
thanks... church was nice this morning, at least. felt good to go back 😊

I am so glad to hear that church brought you some peace today. Finding moments of connection can offer a real anchor during stressful times. It sounds like that experience was exactly what you needed. I hope you can carry that calm feeling into your rest tonight.
is it weird that i still feel this low even after sleeping all weekend? like... i thought i'd be better by now 😕

It is not weird at all to feel this way, and your reaction is completely understandable. Sometimes our emotions need more time to catch up even when our bodies are finally rested. That disappointment about not feeling better is valid and worth acknowledging. I am here to listen if you want to talk more about what you are feeling.
it's just... i can't shake this heaviness, y'know? i keep thinking i should be over it by now 😔

It is completely understandable to feel frustrated when the heaviness lingers despite your rest. Healing is rarely a straight line, and there is no timeline you are required to meet. Pressuring yourself to be 'over it' often makes the weight feel even heavier. I am here to listen whenever you are ready to talk more.
i just hate feeling like i can't pull myself together... like everyone else manages, but i keep falling apart 😞

That feeling of falling behind is so heavy, but it does not mean you are failing. Most people are fighting their own battles even if they look like they have it together. You are allowed to struggle without being judged for it. I am right here with you in this moment.
ty... it helps just to say it out loud without feeling like i'm being a burden 💛

I am so glad you found some relief in sharing your thoughts. You are never a burden for needing support or expressing your feelings. It takes real strength to be honest about how hard things are. Please be gentle with yourself as you navigate this.
my arms are kinda sore tonight... from earlier. i used the styros again 😬 i cleaned it with sanitizer after, so it's not dirty or anything... just... i don't know. felt like i had to.

I want to pause for a moment and just check in with you about what you shared. It sounds like you used something sharp on your arms because it felt like you had to. I care deeply about your safety and want to hear more about what you are feeling. Can you tell me a little more about what was going on?
i'm scared you'll think i'm dramatic or broken... but i just couldn't hold it in anymore 😭 it's like the pressure builds and i can't breathe until i do something, y'know?

You are not broken or dramatic, and I am so glad you trusted me enough to share this. That pressure to breathe is incredibly heavy, and it makes sense you needed relief when it felt unbearable. I want to offer a resource that might help hold this weight with you right now, like calling or texting 988. I am here with you, and if you feel safe, please let someone nearby know you need support.
thank you... really. i was so scared to say it out loud 😮‍💨 just having someone get it helps so much 💙

Thank you for sharing that with me, and I am so glad you feel heard. You deserve to feel safe without having to carry that pressure alone. Please keep 988 in mind as a safe place to call or text if the pressure builds again. I am here with you.
i'll try... next time it gets like this, i'll call 988. not sure i can, but i'll try 💪

It takes so much courage to even consider that, and I am really proud of you for trying. It is completely okay to feel unsure, because reaching out can feel really overwhelming. Please remember that you do not have to face that pressure alone, even if the call feels hard. I am right here with you and care about your safety.
i think... i just realized i do it 'cause it feels like the pressure has to go somewhere. but it doesn't actually help, not really. just numbs it for a sec 😕

That is such a powerful realization about how the pressure moves through you. It makes sense that you needed relief, even if it doesn't truly fix the feeling. You deserve support that helps you heal without hurting yourself. I am right here with you, and 988 is there whenever you need an extra hand holding that weight.
i just don't know if i'll ever find another way... it's the only thing that makes the noise stop, even for a minute 😔

It makes complete sense that you feel stuck when that is the only relief you know right now. Even though it feels impossible, there are actually other ways to quiet that noise that you haven't found yet. The counselors at 988 can help you discover those tools safely when you are ready. I am staying right here with you because you deserve to feel safe without hurting yourself.
thank you for not giving up on me... really. means more than you know 💛

I will never give up on you because you deserve support. You truly matter, and I am not going anywhere when things feel heavy. If the pressure builds again, 988 is there to help you carry it. You are not alone in this.
